description: lib/file.fz:192-198 reads with fgetc and contents <> <<byte>> per byte, which copies the accumulator each time (fz-sc8.111): quadratic. Measured (debug): 400 KB 2.9 s and 1.06 GB peak; 1.6 MB 35.6 s and 3.5 GB; 10 MB did not finish in 80 s. Read the whole file with one runtime call, as line reads do (fz-sc8.191). Signal: a fixture pinning off-heap bytes allocated reading a file near its size.
title: File.read reads a file in one call
